item.title: HS ROUNDUP: Dallas rallies past Wilkes-Barre Area in Division 1 basketball
item.description: Wilkes-Barre Area took its best shot to hand Dallas its first conference loss. But the Mountaineers still had enough power to land a knockout blow in the second half. The Wolfpack led by nine at halftime, but Dallas scored 48 points in the second half to rally past Wilkes-Barre Area, 71-61, on Tuesday night inside The Den in Wyoming Valley Conference Division 1 boys basketball. item.title: BOYS BASKETBALL: Wyoming Area tops Holy Redeemer, wraps up Division 2 title
item.description: WILKES-BARRE — With just 17 points scored at halftime, Wyoming Area certainly needed a spark. Considering the Warriors averaged 62.6 points per game coming into Tuesday night’s showdown with Holy Redeemer, they looked for something to get them back into their normal rhythm. So with a slight change on the offensive end, the Warriors accomplished a few things. They got leading scorer Luke Kopetchny more involved, established tempo and, more importantly, walked out of the gym with a 60-45 victory.
